h1: WaterSound "You are my sunshine..." 215 Salt Box Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:**Private Deeded Beach Access**- Gated Community with on-site Security- Grill- Furnished porch- Private Pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $30 per day**- Poolside fire pit- Fireplace- 2nd living area/den/office- 4 Adult bikes- 4 Seater Golf Cart - From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes two beach sets (4 chairs and 2 umbrellas).- Free WiFi- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout *This property comes with 2 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.LOCATION: This home is a 5-minute walk and a 1-minute bike ride to the beach.DETAILS: 215 Salt Box Lane is a shingle-style 3-bedroom, 4-bath beach home in WaterSound—plus a loft. This vacation home has received recent upgrades that ensure a comfortable stay, including a fabulous in-ground pool with a fire pit nearby, and now with 2 parking spaces.Upon entering, you will be awe-struck by the spacious great room's warm tones and comfortable furnishings. The relaxing living room, well-appointed dining room, and gourmet kitchen feature an open floor plan, which is perfect for entertaining or relaxing after a fun-filled day at the beach. You and your guests will enjoy homemade meals from the fabulous kitchen with its high-end appliances, granite countertops, stunning cabinetry, and fantastic breakfast bar.Rounding out the first floor is the peaceful primary suite, complete with a king-sized bed and spa-like bathroom with a single vanity and walk-in shower. Connected to the primary bathroom is an additional full bath with a shower-over-tub combo.On the second floor, you will find the other primary suite, including a comfortable king bed and a connecting bathroom with a single vanity and walk-in shower. There is also a bedroom with a bunk bed on this floor that has a connecting bathroom with a single vanity and shower-over-tub combination. You can also find a fantastic loft with a queen and twin bed, as well as a sitting area on the second floor. There are 3 smart TVs, 5 HD flat screens, and Sonos Audio.This house has ample indoor and outdoor space with a superb screened-in porch, a poolside fire pit, and a remarkable new pool that is a great gathering space for friends and family. This stunning WaterSound home is simply lovely and provides the serenity you have been craving—at one of the most beautiful beach towns in the world!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 8)FIRST FLOOR: Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With ShowerSECOND FLOOR: Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Twin Over Double Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom With Tub/Shower Combo Loft: Queen Bed, Twin Bed, Shared Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combo 360 BLUE STAFF & SERVICES: Exclusive Guest Experiences, Concierge Services, Grocery Delivery, Private Chef & More (Extra costs & advanced notice may be required)*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.

This home permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate. LOCATION: This home is a 5-minute walk and a 1-minute bike ride to the beach. DETAILS: 215 Salt Box Lane is a shingle-style 3-bedroom, 4-bath beach home in WaterSound—plus a loft. This vacation home has received recent upgrades that ensure a comfortable stay, including a fabulous in-ground pool with a fire pit nearby, and now with 2 parking spaces. Upon entering, you will be awe-struck by the spacious great room's warm tones and comfortable furnishings. The relaxing living room, well-appointed dining room, and gourmet kitchen feature an open floor plan, which is perfect for entertaining or relaxing after a fun-filled day at the beach. You and your guests will enjoy homemade meals from the fabulous kitchen with its high-end appliances, granite countertops, stunning cabinetry, and fantastic breakfast bar. Rounding out the first floor is the peaceful primary suite, complete with a king-sized bed and spa-like bathroom with a single vanity and walk-in shower. Connected to the primary bathroom is an additional full bath with a shower-over-tub combo. On the second floor, you will find the other primary suite, including a comfortable king bed and a connecting bathroom with a single vanity and walk-in shower. There is also a bedroom with a bunk bed on this floor that has a connecting bathroom with a single vanity and shower-over-tub combination. You can also find a fantastic loft with a queen and twin bed, as well as a sitting area on the second floor. There are 3 smart TVs, 5 HD flat screens, and Sonos Audio. This house has ample indoor and outdoor space with a superb screened-in porch, a poolside fire pit, and a remarkable new pool that is a great gathering space for friends and family. This stunning WaterSound home is simply lovely and provides the serenity you have been craving—at one of the most beautiful beach towns in the world!
